meta.name: caveman
meta.description: Ultra-compressed communication mode. Cuts output tokens 65% (measured) by speaking like caveman while keeping full technical accuracy. Supports intensity levels: lite, full (default), ultra, wenyan-lite, wenyan-full, wenyan-ultra. Use when user says "caveman mode", "talk like caveman", "use caveman", "less tokens", "be brief", or invokes /caveman. Also auto-triggers when token efficiency is requested.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用原始人语气压缩 AI 回复,最高省 65% 输出量
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果希望 AI 回复更简短、更省 token
copy.tagline_en: Speak caveman to slash token output by up to 65%.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want terse AI responses and lower token usage.

howto.what: 开启后，Claude 的回复会变成极简的'穴居人'风格，省略冠词、客套和赘词，但保留全部技术细节，可减少约 65% 输出 token。这种风格会一直持续，除非你说'stop caveman'或'normal mode'。有 lite、full（默认）、ultra、wenyan 等六档强度可选。
howto.when: 当你说出'caveman mode'、'talk like caveman'、'less tokens'等触发词，或调用 /caveman、要求 token 效率时触发。

say.note: Claude 进入极简回复模式，默认 full 档。
回复更短，省略连接词和客套话。
切换为文言文极简风，字符数大幅下降。

howto.what_en: Claude replies ultra-terse caveman-style, dropping filler but keeping technical accuracy, cutting tokens ~65% (measured). Stays active until 'stop caveman' or 'normal mode'. Six levels: lite, full, ultra, wenyan-lite/full/ultra.
howto.when_en: Triggers on 'caveman mode', 'talk like caveman', 'less tokens', 'be brief', /caveman, or token-efficiency requests.
